title: Oscarr belongs on your radar
description:
If your stack is getting messy, arediss/Oscarr is worth a look. A modern, self-hosted media request & management platform. Radarr & Sonarr are the source of truth. Oscarr is the interface. It has about 37 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/arediss/Oscarr

#GitHub #OpenSource #Developer #Programming #Shorts
